title: Machine learning detects vascular cognitive impairment from clinical data and MRI
summary: Five algorithms (XGBoost, SVM, logistic regression, Gaussian naive Bayes, random forest) with SHAP-based reduction gave an eight-variable model with AUC 0.956 internally and 0.919 externally in 82 participants. DTI markers along the lateral cholinergic pathway were most informative. The cohorts are retrospective, regional and cross-sectional.
ai_technology: XGBoost, SVM, logistic regression, Gaussian naive Bayes and random forest with SHAP
